interpretation: These answers distinguish recognition of the intended self-plugging joke from certainty about literal attachment geometry.
The sculpture-only answers demonstrate access to the head-versus-outlet distinction under an open description prompt. The pilot does not support a blanket inability to perceive this attachment.

None of the comparisons endorses the author's specific attachment-mismatch judgement. This is a finding about the responses, not proof that the reference and sculpture are geometrically equivalent. Shared omissions in one model's descriptions and comparisons cannot independently establish reference fidelity.

The responses report uncertainty about attachment; that does not establish ambiguity or insufficient grounding in the source drawing. Failure to attend to or integrate distinguishing visual cues is an alternative. Reconstruction follow-up changes interpretation, attention and geometric constraints together, so their contributions remain unseparated.
No model-wide rate, architectural mechanism, training objective or statistically reliable treatment effect is established.
